lines.text: Jesus says He came to fulfill the Law and the Prophets, and righteousness must exceed that of the scribes and Pharisees.
Jesus says anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment, and anyone who says 'You fool!' to the fire of hell.
Jesus says to leave your gift before the altar and first be reconciled to your brother, or you may be thrown into prison until you pay the last talent.
Jesus says not to swear by heaven, the earth, Jerusalem or your head, but to let your 'Yes' be 'Yes.'
Jesus says if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him three miles.
